S031-CHAR3: In normal form (6.7), a_4=−1 and a_6=0, so the written equations become u⁴=1 and r³−r=0. Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 3, they have four and three distinct roots respectively. The displayed law has a normal translation subgroup of order 3 and quotient of order 4; an element u with u²=−1 acts nontrivially. For example, the two orders of (u,0) and (1,1) give (u,−1) and (u,1). This checks the claimed noncommutativity and order 12 from the written law.

All are simple (derivatives u², 1, 1), yielding 24 parameter triples over an algebraic closure. This checks the parameter count asserted on scan 30; it does not identify the abstract group asked for in ‘structure ?’.
